description: This PHP source file defines the class D7TaxonomyTermDeriver, which is responsible for deriving migration configurations for Drupal 7 taxonomy terms based on vocabularies. It includes methods for creating derivatives based on source plugin data, handling requirements checks, and integrating with Drupal's migration and plugin systems.

classes.description: A class that derives migration configurations for Drupal 7 taxonomy terms based on vocabularies, integrating with Drupal's migration plugin system.
